Name: Junimo Hats
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fw6Hlj2.png[/img]

Pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2221]Better Junimos[/url].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/asuQXFm.png[/img]

- 21 Junimo Theme'd Hats

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore
[/url]- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] (optional)﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, SpaceCore, and Content Patcher.
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 2 files included in the download:

[JA] Junimo Hats
[CP] Random Junimo Hats

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]

- Delete every existing item made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods

[color=#ff7700][b]If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.[/b][/color]

Downloads.Description:
A set of 21 junimo hats for Json Assets. Random & Animated hats have been added into the main file. You can toggle these features in the config or through GMCM.

Adds Chinese translations thanks to asqwedcxz741
